semantics.prospecting_required_capital: Private capital required for one coarse regional characterization project; not development capex.
semantics.prospecting_information_value: Authored decision value of further characterization only; not resource, reserve, production, or development value.
semantics.investment_proxy_units_per_model_currenc: High-sensitivity bridge from the promoted Earth investment capacity proxy to bounded simulation model currency.
semantics.mobilization_m_max: Maximum share of normalized Earth investment capacity mobilized into available Offworld financing cash.
semantics.race_pressure: Normal-baseline actor-visible race-pressure input. Strategic pressure is their bounded sum.

mobilization_function: I_MODEL=I_PROXY/INVESTMENT_PROXY_UNITS_PER_MODEL_CURRENCY; O_IN_{0,1}; S=CLAMP(BASE_SALIENCE+RACE_PRESSURE,0,1); m=M_MAX WHEN (O=1 OR S>0), OTHERWISE 0; M=I_MODEL*m
mobilization_parameterization_note: This is a bounded activation gate, not a response curve: Increment 4 supplies no authority for commercial/strategic weights, interaction terms, or additive/nonlinear scoring. Records retain O and S separately.
